Task: Summarize the plot of any Shakespeare play in three sentences.

In *Macbeth*, a Scottish general encounters three witches who prophesy that he will become king, spurring him and his ambitious wife to murder King Duncan and seize the throne. Wracked by guilt and paranoia, Macbeth becomes a tyrant, ordering more killings to secure his power as he is haunted by visions and the unraveling of his sanity. Eventually, a rebellion led by Macduff and Malcolm topples Macbeth, who is killed in battle, restoring order to Scotland.
